# Ana Lucia Ferreira

Grants officer at the Vellacott Fund for Writers, the charitable trust that gives Development Awards of up to 6,000 GBP to published writers. External; no affiliation hub in this vault.

## Role

She runs the Development Award rounds: answers eligibility questions, checks applications for completeness, and sits with the panel as secretary without a vote. She does not assess applications herself.

## How We Work Together

One call so far, on [[vellacott-eligibility-call-2026-09-08|8 September 2026]], booked through the fund's website, twenty minutes. She was clear, quick and helpful about the one thing I needed to know: a contracted book is eligible if the advance and its payment schedule are declared in full and the budget explains what the award pays for that the advance does not ([[does-the-vellacott-award-fund-a-contracted-book]]). She also suggested I keep the statement under 1,000 words "even though the form allows you to go over", which I did.

She acknowledged the application on the afternoon it went in, 2026-10-16, and confirmed that the panel meets in late November with decisions sent on 2026-12-11.

## Notes

- She asked that writers do not chase between submission and decision. I will not.
- She is Portuguese-speaking and noticed my translations on the form. We spent two minutes on that, which is the sort of thing to remember and not overuse.
